description: Submit a request for quotes for a real buyer who explicitly agreed to be contacted by matched suppliers (consent=true). Stored, auto-matched to providers by job + country, and reviewed by a human before anything is forwarded; nothing is emailed automatically. Returns id, status, matched provider ids, and a private status_url/access key for get_rfq_status. Use test=true for testing.

consent.description: Must be true: the buyer agreed to share the request (incl. email) with matched suppliers

country.description: Buyer country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 ("AE") or English name ("United Arab Emirates").

extra.description: Answers to the job checklist, keyed as in get_rfq_template

job.description: One sentence: what, where, how big

provider_hint.description: Optional provider id the buyer prefers

test.description: Mark as a test (excluded from stats, deleted)

name: submit_rfq
title: Submit a request for quotes
